{{recipe}}

== Ingredients ==
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Brie Cheese|Brie cheese]], rind removed
* ¾ cup [[Cookbook:Mascarpone Cheese|mascarpone]] cheese
* ½ cup white granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* ½ cup unsalted [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]], melted
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pinch|pinch]] of salt
* ½ dough from [[Cookbook:Classic American Apple Pie|Classic American Apple Pie]], made with [[Cookbook:Mascarpone Cheese|mascarpone cheese]] instead of applejack

== Procedure ==
#Mash together all ingredients except dough. Set aside.
#[[Cookbook:Dough#Rolling|Roll out]] dough into a rough circle. Place dough in a 10-inch [[Cookbook:Pie and Tart Pans|tart pan]] to make a tart shell, and remove the excess dough from the edges.
#Transfer the cheese mixture into tart shell and [[Cookbook:Baking|bake]] at 425°F on the bottom of the oven for 15 minutes. Move to the bottom rack and bake for 10 minutes more.
#Remove and let rest 10 minutes. Serve.
